(Published by Authority) PART III — LANDS Land Acquisition Notices

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My No. : DS/MN/LB/05/AQ/WPP/PhI.Ext./09. Land Ministry No. : 4-3/11/2022/CEB/139. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose.
Description of the land or servitude to be acquired :

The lands allotment called Nayaruttanpannai, in total extent of about 2.5715 Hectares depicted as Lot Nos. 1, 2, 3 & 4 in Plan No. Cadastral - 940062, Block No. 03, Sheet No. 02 and prepared by Surveyor General situated in the village called Thoddaveli, in the Grama Niladari Division No. 62 of Thoddaveli in the Divisional Secretary's division of Mannar Town of Mannar district in Northern Province.
Plan No. - Cadastral - 940062, Block No. 03, Sheet No. 02

01. Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: Nayaruttanpannai; Present use of the Land: Garden Contain Bushes; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: A. M. Mazoon of Erikalmpiddi, Mannar; Extent: 1.4451 Hectares. 02. Lot No. 2 Name of the Land: Nayaruttanpannai; Present use of the Land: Garden Contain 25 Palmyra trees (15-18 years);

Claimant: State; Original Claimant: M. M. Peciano of No. 20, Hospital Road, Sinnakadai; Extent: 0.7421 Hectare. 03. Lot No. 3 Name of the Land: Nayaruttanpannai; Present use of the Land: Garden Contain Bushes; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Not Known; Extent: 0.0493 Hectare. 04. Lot No. 4 Name of the Land: Nayaruttanpannai; Present use of the Land: Garden Contain Bushes; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Not Known; Extent: 0.3350 Hectare. The dates and the time of the inquiries : All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at 10.00 a.m. on the 23rd day of April 2025 at Divisional Secretariat Mannar Town. And further you are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 16th day of April 2025 the nature of their interest in the land, the particulars of their claims for the compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. M. Pංඋൺඍඁൾൾඉ, Divisional Secretary, Mannar Town. Divisional Secretariat of Mannar Town, 14th March, 2025

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7 My No. : DS/MN/LB/05/AQ/WPP/PhI.Ext/10. Land Ministry No. : 4-3/11/2022/CEB/140. I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose. Description of the land or servitude to be acquired : The lands allotment called Kurusadikani, in total extent of about 2.5633 Hectares depicted as Lot Nos. 1, 2, 3 and 4 in Plan No. Cadastral - 940062, Block No. 02, Sheet No. 01 and prepared by Surveyor General situated in the village called Thoddaveli in the Grama Niladari Division No. 62 of Thoddaveli in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Mannar Town of Mannar District in Northern Province. Plan No. - Cadastral - 940062, Block No. 02, Sheet No. 01 01. Lot No. 1 Name of the land: Kurusadikani; Present use of the Land: contain 25 Palmyra trees (15 - 25 years); Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Not Known; Extent: 0.5433 Hectare. 02. Lot No. 2 Name of the land: Kurusadikani; Present use of the Land: Garden contain 25 Palmyra trees (25 - 30 years); Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Summer Organic Farms (Pvt.) Ltd., No. 433, Havelock Road, Colombo 06; Extent: 0.8207 Hectare. 03. Lot No. 3 Name of the land: Kurusadikani; Present use of the Land: Garden contain 25 Palmyra trees (15 - 20 years) and a Permanent Building; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Balakrishnan Jhondas, Pallimunai, Mannar; Extent: 0.8603 Hectare. 04. Lot No. 4 Name of the land: Kurusadikani; Present use of the Land: Garden contain 10 Palmyra trees (15 - 20 years); Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Samsudeen Mohamed Hasmin, Tharapuram, Mannar; Extent: 0.3380 Hectare. The dates and the time of the inquiries :

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at 10.00 a.m. on the 23rd day of April 2025 at Divisional Secretariat Mannar Town. And further you are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 16th day of April 2025 the nature of their interest in the land, the particulars of their claims for the compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.

M. Pංඋൺඍඁൾൾඉ, Divisional Secretary, Mannar Town.
